outcomes.name: The stakeholder engagement approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The stakeholder engagement approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on People Experience & Culture to identify what needs to change in the stakeholder engagement approach before scaling.
Refine the stakeholder engagement approach to People Experience & Culture based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined stakeholder engagement approach covering People Experience & Culture ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined stakeholder engagement approach for People Experience & Culture is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the stakeholder engagement approach for People Experience & Culture remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the stakeholder engagement approach affected Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Adapt the stakeholder engagement approach relating to Strategic Direction & Leadership for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the stakeholder engagement approach covering Strategic Direction & Leadership to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the stakeholder engagement approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
